summary: Iteration 7 validated the user-reported bug fix ('réponses aux questions ne s'enregistrent pas + réécoute avant sauvegarde') and did the general verification on the PUBLIC preview URL. Backend: 29/29 pytest pass (5 suites), POST /api/tts empty text now returns 400 (was 422). MAIN BUG FIX VALIDATED end-to-end: fiche Jeanne -> atelier -> Question guidée -> Écouter la question (POST /api/tts 200, label 'Lecture en cours…') -> record ~4s -> Terminer -> timer shows 00:04 (NOT 00:00 - chrono maison works) -> Réécouter (no error, no audio session blockage) -> Sauvegarder -> server capsule has duration_sec=4, theme 'Enfance', question title, auto-transcription arrived in seconds. Full chain TTS -> record -> replay -> record with zero audio blockage (setAudioModeAsync fixes verified on web; iOS écouteur fix is code-verified, not device-verifiable here). Notice toast auto-dismisses after ~6s (was blocking bottom CTAs). Capsule action row flexWrap verified ('Partager à la famille' wraps to 2nd line at 390px). General verification all pass: home logo, mode spontané (save -> bascule questions du jour), profile creation WITH photo (file chooser -> preview), archive (search hit/miss/empty state, resident filter, play/pause aria-label switch, TTS Écouter, Retranscrire, Partager -> 'Lien de partage copié'), espace pro (PIN create 1234 -> stats, PIN unlock on 2nd gate), merge duplicates (2x TEST_Merge -> fusion -> group gone), remove profile (PIN gate -> export popup ZIP -> export-done -> confirm -> resident gone + notice). Zero console errors across 5 sessions. BONUS real-world confirmation: a real user recorded concurrently during testing (09:45:50, 24s question answer + 09:46 8s free mode, both with REAL French transcriptions and CORRECT durations) - the duration fix works in real usage, not just fake-mic tests.
action_items: Optional (code health): /app/frontend/app/index.tsx is ~960 lines (>700 guideline) - consider splitting screens/modals into separate component files.

Optional: playingCapsuleId is derived by matching player source URI against capsule.audio_uri (index.tsx ~line 505) - works but fragile if two capsules share a URI; a dedicated playingId state would be cleaner.
No blocking issues. All 6 announced fixes verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: Chrono fix (index.tsx lines 184-191): elapsedSec increments only while recorderStatus==='recording', durationSeconds = max(elapsedSec, durationMillis/1000) - correct fallback for web where durationMillis stays 0. Reset present in beginWorkshop (307), handleRecordPress (331), resetRecording (347). Verified live: 00:04 displayed and duration_sec=4 persisted server-side.

Audio session fix: setAudioModeAsync({allowsRecording:false, playsInSilentMode:true}) called before TTS playback (552), capsule player (569), and workshop replay (onPlay, 793); handleRecordPress re-enables allowsRecording:true (329). Chain TTS->record->replay->record tested in one session with no blockage. iOS écouteur behavior cannot be verified on Chromium - code is correct per expo-audio docs.
TTS 400 fix (server.py 688-704): min_length removed from TtsRequest, empty text now hits normalized-text check -> 400 'Texte vide'. Verified via curl AND test_empty_text_rejected.
Notice auto-dismiss (194-198): 6s timeout with cleanup. Verified: notice present right after save, gone after 6.5s.
flexWrap fix (129): capsuleActions now 'flexWrap: wrap, rowGap: 4' - screenshot confirms 'Partager à la famille' on 2nd row at 390px.
No deprecated Expo packages (expo-audio, expo-file-system/legacy, expo-image, expo-sharing, expo-clipboard all current). No red screens, zero console errors in 5 sessions.

Test-harness note (not app bugs): RNW bottom-sheet buttons (add-resident, merge, remove modals) fail Playwright native click with 'outside of viewport' - use evaluate(scrollIntoView + click). Export/carnet web popup (window.open to download URL) never fires load event - wait for export-done marker instead of popup load.

rca_of_issue: Original user bug had 2 root causes, both confirmed fixed: (1) Durations saved as 00:00: expo-audio's recorderState.durationMillis stays 0 on web -> duration_sec=0 persisted (evidence: capsule 15c8f613 recorded 09:37 pre-fix has duration_sec=0; post-fix capsules at 09:43/09:45 have 4/3/3/24). Fixed by home-made elapsedSec chronometer. (2) Replay inaudible/blocked: after recording, the audio session stayed in play-and-record mode, so replay-before-save and fiche playback were broken (on iOS real device, sound routed to earpiece). Fixed by setAudioModeAsync({allowsRecording:false}) before every playback + re-enabling allowsRecording on record. Verified: TTS->record->replay->Recommencer->record chain works flawlessly; the 'sauvegarde' itself was already working on web.
